_doc: What notable investors, fund managers and CEOs are saying about tech valuations. Quotes are copied word for word from the linked article (which may itself quote a post on Substack, LinkedIn or X). Newest first; keep about the last two months. Every row needs a source link.

quotes.role: Chief US equity strategist, Morgan Stanley
quotes.quote: This is the fat pitch we have patiently been waiting for, and we're not going to miss it
quotes.context: In a Monday research note arguing the November selloff pushed the S&P 500 below fair value.

quotes.role: Chief investment officer, Ocean Park Asset Management
quotes.quote: Jensen's return doesn't answer the big questions investors were grappling with regarding the ROI on the AI build-out
quotes.context: To Reuters, after Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO and AI stocks rebounded.

quotes.quote: Right now it looks cheap, but will companies like Micron and Nvidia actually deliver?
quotes.context: On CNBC's ETF Edge, discussing AI stock valuations after the November selloff and Anthropic's IPO.

quotes.quote: The rule from history is that great technological innovations lead to great bubbles.
The press has now started to do its job on NVIDIA
quotes.context: In a Substack post as Nvidia shares slid.

quotes.role: Led by Ben Snider, 2027 equity outlook
quotes.quote: the outlook for AI investment and corporate profit margins in 2028 and beyond is highly uncertain
quotes.context: They estimate the AI investment boom has lifted S&P 500 earnings 25% above trend.

quotes.quote: If we fail to address this, the concern that AI might be a bubble could well become a reality
quotes.context: At the APEC CEO Summit, on AI spending that has yet to produce profits.

quotes.role: Korean VC firm (unnamed in the article)
quotes.quote: Investment in AI is not a trend that emerged this year; it has built up over several years
quotes.context: On whether a softer Anthropic IPO dampens AI investment.

quotes.quote: There are many, many software companies in the public markets that will be disrupted from AI
quotes.context: He called some valuation cuts warranted, but said others hit businesses that will be big winners.
